Stock market news | Swara Baby Products sets ₹800 crore IPO price band

Diaper maker Swara Baby Products has fixed its IPO price band at ₹105 to ₹111 per share. The company cut its issue size to ₹800 crore, comprising a fresh issue of ₹500 crore and an offer for sale worth ₹300 crore.
